name: Park Jae-hyun
bio:
Park Jae-hyun's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, fueled by a late-night documentary about Formula 1 aerodynamics during his university years. Despite initially pursuing a degree in mechanical engineering with a focus on robotics, the allure of high-speed innovation and downforce calculations proved irresistible. He shifted his studies, devouring every textbook and research paper he could find on fluid dynamics and computational fluid dynamics (CFD). His first role was as a junior aerodynamicist for a small, independent racing team, where he quickly earned a reputation for his meticulous attention to detail and tireless work ethic.

While his technical skills are still developing, Park's approach to leading the aero department is rooted in fostering collaboration and open communication. He believes that the best aerodynamic solutions emerge from a diverse range of perspectives and a relentless pursuit of incremental improvements. His loyalty to his team and his unyielding ambition to push the boundaries of aerodynamic performance make him a valuable asset, even as he continues to hone his expertise. He's determined to make a significant contribution to the team's success, driven by a desire to prove that hard work and dedication can overcome any obstacle.

What sets Park apart is his intuitive understanding of airflow, often visualizing complex aerodynamic phenomena in his mind's eye. While some may see him as reserved, his passion for aerodynamics is undeniable, and he is always eager to share his knowledge and insights with others.
